audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 gave you the row at 8/10 while whys[0] says 'a clean skirmish favors neither side — just farm'. 2+ items gave you the row at 8/10 while whys[6] and spikes[3] both say she out-scales you outright. First item read Skill while whys[5] says your all-in is lethal there.
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Irelia, and the mirror has already flipped Level 1 to Skill and 2+ items to Irelia. The 2+ items row was the damaging one: it told a player to keep dueling a two-item Irelia, which is the single mistake that loses this matchup.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic group in both layers — Skill 5/10, Mordekaiser 7/10, Irelia 3/10 — and phases[6].why rewritten to state her spike instead of promising an unloseable Realm.

audit.why: The four spikes are right and already give Irelia her own window at 2+ items rather than pretending the Realm scales forever.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. First, breakdown.cooldowns lists Flawless Duet twice, once as 'Flawless Duet (Stun)' and once as 'Flawless Duet', with no cooldowns on either. Second — the important one — the page says Defiant Dance 'eats your Obliterate burst' and that you should hold R until her damage reduction is down so it 'can't blunt your aura tick and Obliterate burst'.
audit.why: Riot's Defiant Dance text says she takes reduced PHYSICAL damage during the charge. Every point of Mordekaiser's damage is magic, so Defiant Dance does nothing against your kit — waiting out a 20-second cooldown that never applied to you costs you the trades you were supposed to take. The mirror agent found the same error from the other side. Real numbers that do matter: Flawless Duet 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Bladesurge 10/9/8/7/6 refreshing on a Marked or dying target, Defiant Dance 20/18/16/14/12.
audit.corrected: Duplicate line replaced with real cooldowns for E, Q and W; the Defiant Dance damage-reduction claim removed from whys[3] and replaced with the reset-and-heal that actually keeps that row close.
sources: enemyKit Irelia W text ('reduced physical damage')

audit.whatIsWrong: Vanguard's Edge is described only as damage — nothing says the blades leave a wall behind.
audit.why: Riot's R text: the blades form a wall that damages and slows enemies walking through it. You have no dash, so that wall is what turns a survivable trade into a death, and it is the reason to hold Flash for the wall rather than for the burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal named anywhere against a champion who heals on every Bladesurge.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her and refreshes on any dying target, so a big wave is both her mobility and her sustain — thinning it is the itemization-free half of the answer, Grievous Wounds is the other.
audit.corrected: The reset-and-heal loop stated in dontsFull[0].d and whys[3].

edits.after: She out-scales you here: Trinity Force, on-hit DPS and Bladesurge resets kite an aura you cannot chase — save Realm of Death to isolate her, never to duel her.

edits.after: You stay favoured as Darkness Rise grinds extended fights, but Bladesurge resets off any dying minion and heals her back — hence Skill, not yours.

edits.after: - Flawless Duet (E): 16s at rank 1 — two blades that must converge on you, so break the line. - Bladesurge (Q): 10s, but it refreshes on a Marked or dying target. - Defiant Dance (W): 20s.

notes: The Defiant Dance error is the one to look at. Riot's text reduces PHYSICAL damage only and Mordekaiser deals magic damage exclusively, so the ability is irrelevant to your side of this matchup — yet the page tells you twice to play around it. I fixed whys[3] where I had length room. Two more instances remain and did not fit a same-length swap: the `early` block ends 'respect that her Defiant Dance (W) eats your Obliterate burst if she channels it', and `mid` ends 'Hold R for when her Defiant Dance damage-reduction is on cooldown so it can't blunt your aura tick and Obliterate burst'. The second is the costly one — it tells you to delay a 140-second ultimate for a cooldown that never mattered. Both need a rewrite of the surrounding sentence rather than a phrase swap. No suspect names flagged and none found. The kit file's 'grounding' flag on Mordekaiser's Q is unsupported by Riot's description, so I claimed nothing about Obliterate denying Bladesurge; note that Irelia's E genuinely does carry a grounding flag, but Riot's Flawless Duet text mentions only damage, stun and Mark, so I did not assert that either.
